items.stimulus: בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם עַד שׁוּבְךָ אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה כִּי עָפָר אַתָּה וְאֶל־עָפָר תָּשׁוּב
options: In the sweat of thy face thou shalt eat bread till thou return to the ground; for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

If thou shalt at all forget Yahweh thy God and go after other gods and serve them, I (solemnly) testify against thee this day that thou shalt assuredly perish.
